## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed. Link the relevant issue if any.

## Validation

List commands, exit codes, passed/failed/skipped counts, and manual checks.
Explain any unperformed check, its risk, and follow-up.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, and PROJECT-STANDARD.md.
- [ ] Browser data remains read-only, and fixtures contain only synthetic data.
- [ ] Relevant tests, lint, formatting, and type checks passed, or limits are recorded.
- [ ] I reviewed ACCESSIBILITY.md for UI changes and recorded manual checks honestly.
- [ ] Routed documentation and a changelog.d fragment are included where required.
- [ ] No secrets, real bookmark data, or private paths are included.
